What the two App Store screenshot accounts hold, read by scripts/store-seed/seed.mjs (which creates it through the live app's own pages) and by the capture checks in ios-signed-in.yml (which refuse a shot that shows the other language's subject names). Agent drafts for the owner's approval: the notes in ar/ and en/ were written by the agent, original, at Moroccan 2nd year bac level. Subjects are created in the order listed, so the list shows them newest first, in reverse. Four files per account keeps the day's upload allowance (5) intact. One summary, one quiz and one Ask question per account.
